findings.passage: As the number one state for election integrity, Tennessee leads the nation in protecting the ballot box because we are committed to safeguarding the democratic process for current and future generations,” Johnson said. "This legislation is a significant step forward in enhancing the security and trustworthiness of our election system by proposing additional safeguards to ensure that only eligible citizens can participate in the electoral process.
findings.note: Statement issued on filing HB 69, which would have election officials check citizenship with the state safety department at registration, check felony status, and track restored voting rights, for the 2028 presidential election. Quoted by NewsChannel 5.
